## Episode Overview

This episode from the Sample Space: Random Talks podcast welcomes guests Danielle McDonagh (Student Welfare Advisor for second and third-year SEFS students, postgraduate taught students, and PhD students) and Eileen Laffan (Student Welfare Advisor for undergraduate students across all other statistical science degree programs). We hear their thought on removing and reducing barriers to education and engagement.

### <i class="fa-solid fa-door-open"></i> Identifying Barriers
